evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We release the counterfactual benchmark, human authorization reference, and annotation protocol after acceptance.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Personalized shopping benchmarks ask which item fits the user; we ask how far an agent may commit on that item, and pose learning the individual's auto-purchase line as a task.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A shallow learner on a few dozen of a person's own labels predicts their held-out auto-purchase line at a median of 0.79 by 30-40 labels, outperforming every evaluated prompt$\times$model configuration, including a per-annotator oracle over 80 configurations; the learned boundary does not transfer across domains.
